plant_bleeding_heart.note: Each heart falls with its little stalk.

plant_chocolate_cosmos.note: Rose rule reuse: the back ring of 4, then the front ring of 4.

plant_clover.note: Small white flower; droop helps it read.

plant_corpse_flower.note: The spathe is one wrap, not petals: droop only.

plant_ghost_orchid.note: Two side petals, the legged lip (with its shade) and the hood; the yellow column stays.

plant_ghost_pipe.note: Five nodding bells; stems and scales stay.

plant_giant_water_lily.note: Rose rule reuse: pink ring over 2 pips, white over 3; the centre petal stays as the bare head.

plant_hellebore.note: Glasshouse plant (Frost & Lantern): three heads, five sepals each.

plant_hibiscus.note: Rose rule reuse: the big petals over 3 pips (2, 2, 1), the dark inner petals over 2; eye and stamen stay.

plant_jade_vine.note: Ten claws, each with its stalk.

plant_king_protea.note: Rose rule reuse: bract layers outer first (7+7, 7+7, 6+6); the cream dome is the bare head.

plant_ladys_slipper_orchid.note: Two maroon side petals, the dorsal sepal and the top sepal; the yellow slipper stays.

plant_lavender.note: Florets thin up three spikes; the tip buds stay.

plant_lotus.note: Rose rule reuse: peel by shade, outer pair, then the middle and inner petals one a pip; ends as the bare centre bud.

plant_marigold.note: Rose rule reuse: ring by ring, outer over 2 pips, middle over 2, inner last.

plant_orchid.note: Three flowers, five petals each; lip and column stay as the bare centre.

plant_poppy.note: Rose rule reuse: the 2 front petals go, then the 2 back ones, then the r18 cup disc, so the bare head is the black seed pod.

plant_rafflesia.note: Rose rule reuse (TODO): peel the 5 lobes and shrink the rx38 body disc to rx26 at 1 pip; needs the cream warts tagged per lobe first. Droop only until then.

plant_rose.note: Peel rule from the visual lead (notes/rose-rule.md): base disc hidden, five valley petals and a cradle added, outer to inner.

motion.fall: 3.8 s each, staggered 0.32 s; first 0.3 s the sprite fades in over the drawn petal, which fades out (0.35 s). Path: lift 5 out, then x sways sin(2.5 turns) ±14 shrinking to 30%, rocks ±30°, squashes scaleX .55–1 (tumble), y eases down. Rests beside the stem (x 100 ± 22 + 12/pair, y 171), lying: scale(1,.62) rotate(±80..104) scale(.82). Falling layer is in front of the head.
motion.reduceMotion: unit fades out 0.5 s; sprite fades in at its rest spot (0.6 s); regrow is a 0.25 s fade; no sway, no rain
motion.regrow: inner layers first, one pip per 0.3 s; each unit scales .05 → 1.06 → 1 from the head centre (0.65 s spring); settle and splay undo

plant_saguaro_cactus.note: Body droops and greys; the small 7-petal flower on top still sheds.

plant_snapdragon.note: Five florets on one spike; the top buds stay.

plant_snowdrop.note: Glasshouse plant (Frost & Lantern): three nodding heads, three outer tepals each.

plant_strawberry.note: Small white flower; droop helps it read.

plant_sundew.note: Small white flower; droop helps it read.

plant_tulip.note: Rose rule reuse: the front petal goes at 3 pips, the cup on the last pip; droop carries the other pips.
